text:
The Lake Wind Advisory is in effect tonight, so sunset is fine for a shoreline stroll, but the breeze will build after dark. Expect partly cloudy skies through sunset at 7:34, with temperatures easing from the mid 70s toward a low around 60. On the broad lake, south winds could reach 15 to 25 knots and waves build to 1 to 3 feet, so small boats should be back early.

Sunday looks mostly cloudy with a high near 78 and a 30 percent chance of showers, mainly from late morning through the afternoon, with a few rumbles possible. Most guidance keeps us in the upper 70s, but the European model is much cooler, closer to the mid 60s, so I’d keep the forecast flexible and carry a rain jacket. The rain threat rises Sunday night, with a 50 percent chance of showers or a thunderstorm. Good evening plans tonight, but be off the lake before the stronger south wind arrives.
